name_zh: 皮诺切特/芝加哥男孩/智利新自由主义：新自由主义实验室与转型正义
name_en: Pinochet/Chicago Boys/Chilean Neoliberalism: Neoliberal Laboratory & Transitional Justice
description_zh: 智利奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (1915-2006) 1973 政变/芝加哥男孩/新自由主义休克疗法/私有化/开放/养老金/教育/医疗/1980 宪法/1988 公投/1990 民主转型/艾尔文/拉戈斯/巴切莱特/皮涅拉/博里奇/2022 宪法公投/2023 新宪法草案。核心张力：新自由主义实验室/不平等/转型正义/宪法重写/社会权利/养老金/教育/医疗/水权/原住民。体现 M214 新自由主义实验室与转型正义 — 以"休克疗法+芝加哥男孩+转型公约+宪法重写"四位一体，在独裁/新自由主义/民主转型/宪法进程四重历史层叠中构建智利特色转型范式。
description_en: Chile Augusto Pinochet (1915-2006) 1973 coup/Chicago Boys/neoliberal shock therapy/privatization/opening/pensions/education/healthcare/1980 Constitution/1988 plebiscite/1990 democratic transition/Aylwin/Lagos/Bachelet/Pinera/Boric/2022 constitutional plebiscite/2023 new draft. Core tensions: neoliberal laboratory/inequality/transitional justice/constitutional rewriting/social rights/pensions/education/healthcare/water rights/indigenous. Exemplifies M214 Neoliberal Laboratory & Transitional Justice — quaternity of 'shock therapy + Chicago Boys + transition pact + constitutional rewrite' building Chilean characteristic transition paradigm amid quadruple historical layers of dictatorship/neoliberalism/democratic transition/constitutional process.
reason_zh: 智利非单纯新自由主义实验场，而是"休克疗法+转型公约+宪法重写"三位一体转型样本。芝加哥男孩重塑经济，转型公约保障民主回归，宪法重写试图超越 1980 宪法。M214 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁)、M198 内陆枢纽(老挝)，核心在于"休克疗法即实验室+转型公约即政治契约+宪法重写即社会契约"的智利转型范式。
reason_en: Chile not mere neoliberal laboratory but 'shock therapy + transition pact + constitutional rewrite' trinity transition sample. Chicago Boys reshaped economy, transition pact guaranteed democratic return, constitutional rewrite attempts to transcend 1980 Constitution. M214 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru), M198 Landlocked Hub (Laos), core: 'shock therapy as laboratory + transition pact as political contract + constitutional rewrite as social contract' Chilean transition paradigm.
